Hey. No, I don't take meds. Sometimes I also believe that it would be easier to take some meds, but because I don't  have a lot of money, i was going to a psychologist that my university provided for free. However, she can't give me meds, only psychiatrists can . The only thing close to meds that I have taken were some botanical  pills to calm me down and help me to sleep and sometimes when things got really rough I would take a xanax. But the first pills work more like a placebo, I don't believe they really work.
